$comment: THE EDITABLE STORYBOARD. 24 slots / 26 cuts cut to the measured 106 BPM / 60-bar grid in beatmap.json. Every start/end lands on a bar line. Edit action/expression/camera/caption/continuity/lyric_intent/overrides; keep items consistent (see app/ items.schema.json). `lyric_lines` is generated by scripts/align_lyrics.py — do not hand-edit it. `caption` and lyric subtitles are two different things; where both fall on the same shot the caption wins. Compile with app/scripts/build.py.

defaults.negative: extra fingers, deformed hands, inconsistent hair color, changed outfit, text artifacts, watermark, multiple characters

shots.camera: extreme close-up on closed eyes, slow push-in
shots.action: darkness, a single cold rim light traces LUNA's profile; she is perfectly still, eyes closed
shots.sync: no bass (0.12x) - hold on stillness, let the pad breathe
shots.continuity_in: cold dark, nothing yet; the frame itself is switching on
shots.continuity_out: profile traced by the rim light, eyes still closed, completely still
shots.lyric_intent: the rim light IS the 'signal lighting up'; her closed eyes are a screen waiting to power on (L01 訊號亮起 畫面開啟)

shots.camera: wide, high angle, static
shots.action: she stands alone at centre stage, tiny in an empty dark arena, chains on her skirt catching a faint violet glint
shots.sync: airy pad only - emptiness is the point
shots.continuity_in: the same stillness as the close-up, now revealed from high above
shots.continuity_out: she stands alone at stage centre, a faint violet glint on her chains
shots.lyric_intent: the countdown begins: an empty arena reads as a world about to restart around her (L02 倒數開始 世界重啟)

shots.camera: medium close-up, 3/4, slow tilt up
shots.action: her eyes snap open on the last beat before the bass, violet iris catching light
shots.sync: 1 bar - land the eye-open exactly on 0:11.81
shots.continuity_in: hold her face in the dark, 3/4 medium close-up, tilt beginning to rise
shots.continuity_out: eyes snapped open, violet iris catching light, gaze aimed forward and up into the bass drop
shots.lyric_intent: the eyes open exactly as '321' resolves — the wake-up beat of the whole track (L03 321 LIVE AI)

shots.camera: low angle full body, fast dolly-in
shots.action: BASS HITS - every stage light snaps on behind her at once, silhouette blowing out to full colour, ponytail lifting
shots.sync: HARD CUT on bass entry (+5.5 dB). The first real impact.
shots.continuity_in: her open eyes; the dark arena floods with light behind her the instant the bass hits
shots.continuity_out: full-colour figure, ponytail lifted, facing down the lens as the dolly lands
shots.lyric_intent: 'LIVE AI' slams with the bass: the silhouette drowning in stage light = the world rebooting at full volume (L03)

shots.camera: orbit around her, medium full shot
shots.action: first dance hook - sharp arm snap on each downbeat, camera circling 90 degrees
shots.sync: downbeats at 16.34 / 18.60 / 20.86 - snap poses on each
shots.continuity_in: continues dancing from S04's landing pose, medium full, orbit beginning
shots.continuity_out: arm snapped out on the final downbeat pose, camera 90 degrees around her
shots.lyric_intent: she performs the countdown hook with her body; the dance is the image being born (L03 → L04 一張空白的畫面)
shots.caption: LIVE AI

shots.camera: tracking side profile, walking
shots.action: arrangement thins out; she walks a neon-wet city street at night, reflections rippling under her platform sneakers
shots.sync: bass drops to 0.62x - pull back to narrative
shots.continuity_in: the dance energy cools; the world cuts to a night street, she walks in profile
shots.continuity_out: she walks left, reflections rippling under her sneakers, the street opening ahead
shots.lyric_intent: a blank-canvas city: empty street waiting for the first beam; she is the first light moving through it (L04 一張空白的畫面等著第一束光出現)

shots.camera: close-up on face, shallow focus, handheld drift
shots.action: she glances up at something off-frame, city bokeh swimming behind her
shots.sync: vocal band peaks - hold the face

overrides.look.street_neon: bokeh softer and more diffuse, the city lights swimming like a thought forming

shots.continuity_in: her walking slows; the frame holds on her face as she stops
shots.continuity_out: her gaze lifts past the lens toward something off-frame, thinking
shots.lyric_intent: the world materializing at her fingertips: the gaze is the act of creation (L05 一個還沒有人看過的世界正在指尖慢慢浮現)

shots.camera: over-the-shoulder, rack focus to background
shots.action: she turns; a colossal holographic billboard across the street is playing her own face back at her
shots.sync: rack focus on the bar line at 32.19
shots.continuity_in: she turns from the previous glance; over-the-shoulder opens onto the street
shots.continuity_out: the colossal billboard comes into focus, showing her own face back at her
shots.lyric_intent: no studio, no script — and yet her own face is playing on the billboard; the script is writing itself (L06 沒有攝影棚 沒有既定劇本)

shots.camera: insert, extreme close-up on the hologram
shots.action: the projected face glitches - scanlines tear, colour channels split apart
shots.sync: 1 bar stinger
shots.continuity_in: extreme close-up on the billboard's projected face, in focus
shots.continuity_out: the face tears — scanlines ripping, colour channels splitting
shots.lyric_intent: the impossible image tearing into the present: glitches are the thought becoming visual (L07 把腦海裡不可能的畫面現在全部變成眼前)

shots.camera: low angle close-up, slow rise
shots.action: she lifts a hand toward the fracturing hologram, light fragments drifting between her fingers
shots.sync: air band rising to 1.15x - riser begins
shots.continuity_in: she reaches toward the fracturing image; the light falls on her open hand
shots.continuity_out: light fragments drift through her fingers as her hand trembles
shots.lyric_intent: reaching for the fragments: the first prompt becoming the shot, grieving what creation costs (L07 → L08 從第一個 Prompt 到最後一個鏡頭)
shots.caption: 那真的是我嗎？

shots.camera: medium close-up, push-in, whip-pan out on last beat
shots.action: her hand closes into a fist; violet energy gathers around her as the riser peaks
shots.sync: riser tops out at 45.77 - whip-pan is the cut
shots.continuity_in: her hand closes from the reach, violet light spiralling into the fist
shots.continuity_out: riser peaks; the frame whips away on the last beat
shots.lyric_intent: fist closing = every generation a new universe; the violet energy is creation gathering (L09 每一次生成都是新的宇宙)

shots.camera: full body hero shot, low angle, fast push-in
shots.action: CHORUS - she points straight down the lens, stage exploding into neon particles and strobes behind her
shots.sync: HARD CUT on chorus downbeat. First true peak (0.64).
shots.continuity_in: the whip-pan lands on a full-body hero shot; the stage is already exploding behind her
shots.continuity_out: finger pointed straight down the lens, the measure held
shots.lyric_intent: pointing down the lens: creativity decides everything at this moment — the song's thesis as a gesture (L11 這一刻創意決定所有)

shots.camera: wide, crane down over dancers
shots.action: full choreography, backup silhouettes in formation behind her, light sticks flooding the pit
shots.sync: mid band 1.36x - widest frame of the chorus
shots.continuity_in: the hero pose is left; the crane rises over the full formation
shots.continuity_out: backup silhouettes in formation, light sticks flooding the pit, widest frame of the chorus
shots.lyric_intent: the future being created right now: full formation, the widest possible 'now' (L12 LIVE AI 現在就創造未來)

shots.camera: tight close-up, static
shots.action: she winks and throws a peace sign, sparkle bloom across the frame
shots.sync: 1-bar punch-in

overrides.look.expo_burst: sparkles blooming brighter, bursting across the close-up as the wink lands

shots.continuity_in: tight cut-in during the choreography; her face fills the frame
shots.continuity_out: peace sign thrown, sparkle bloom across the frame
shots.lyric_intent: the wink and peace sign = imagination breaking through the frame (L13 讓想像穿越畫面之外)

shots.camera: steadicam figure-8 through the stage, continuous
shots.action: longest continuous take - she moves downstage through light beams, crowd roaring on both sides
shots.sync: 8 bars sustained. Use the model's max clip length here.
shots.continuity_in: the energy carries from the wink; the steadicam starts its figure-8
shots.continuity_out: she moves downstage through light beams, crowd roaring on both sides
shots.lyric_intent: the longest continuous take = the world reopening; she walks a song about opening (L14 LIVE AI 讓世界重新打開)

shots.camera: back view, wide, slow rise to crowd
shots.action: seen from behind, arms spread to an ocean of glowing light sticks
shots.sync: hi/air climbing to 1.28x
shots.continuity_in: from behind her, the stage opens up to the audience
shots.continuity_out: arms spread wide to the ocean of light sticks, the camera rising
shots.lyric_intent: arms open to the light sticks = summoning light, sound and story awake (L16 讓光影 讓聲音 讓故事全部醒來)

shots.camera: rapid 4-cut montage, 1 bar each
shots.action: quick-fire pose cuts: hair flip / footwork / chain swing / chin lift
shots.sync: air peaks 1.44x at 1:10 - fastest cutting in the film
shots.continuity_in: the montage fires off: hair flip opens the four-cut sequence
shots.continuity_out: chin lift on the final beat of the fastest cut in the film
shots.lyric_intent: the fastest cutting in the film = 'impossible becoming now' at maximum velocity (L16 → L17 把不可能變成現在)

shots.camera: slow lateral track, medium
shots.action: lights drop to a single warm wash; she walks the empty stage as the arrangement thins
shots.sync: mid pulls back to 0.90x
shots.continuity_in: the montage snaps to a slow lateral track; the lights drop to a single warm wash
shots.continuity_out: she walks the empty stage, energy gone quiet
shots.lyric_intent: the brand line over a quiet stage: identity, stripped back (L18 CSFCCA LIVE AI)

shots.camera: close-up, soft focus, static
shots.action: she catches her breath, a small private smile, sweat catching the light
shots.sync: hold - the calm before the dropout
shots.continuity_in: close-up, she catches her breath in the warm wash
shots.continuity_out: a private smile, sweat catching the light — the calm before the dropout
shots.lyric_intent: create. make. show. — a private smile: she has done all three tonight (L19 Create it Make it Show me your world)

shots.camera: slow orbit, medium close-up, near-black frame
shots.action: BASS VANISHES - everything cuts to darkness but a single overhead beam; she stands alone singing into the dropout, hologram shards dissolving around her
shots.sync: bass 0.39x falling to 0.02x - the emptiest bar in the track, but the vocal carries through it alone (L20 at 85.0). Instruments drop, she does not.
shots.continuity_in: the bass vanishes; everything cuts to darkness but the overhead beam
shots.continuity_out: she stands alone, hologram shards dissolving around her in the dark
shots.lyric_intent: the dropout is the 'dream' before the build; her voice alone = the future already decided (L20 Dream it Build it / L21 321 LIVE AI 現在就創造未來)

shots.camera: extreme close-up on eyes, hold, then snap to black
shots.action: bare vocal over the empty bar - her eyes lift to the lens on the line, decision made; frame cuts to black on the last beat before the final chorus
shots.sync: 1:30 is the absolute instrumental floor (bass 0.02x), vocal only (L21 89.2 / L22 91.0). The exposed voice is the power, not silence.
shots.continuity_in: hold on her eyes in the near-black, the beam holding her face
shots.continuity_out: eyes lift to the lens, decision made; the frame cuts to black on the last beat
shots.lyric_intent: eyes to the lens on '讓你的世界被所有人看見' — the decision to show her world to everyone (L22)

shots.camera: full body, low angle, explosive push-in then orbit
shots.action: EVERYTHING RETURNS AT ONCE - pyrotechnic light burst, full choreography, maximum energy
shots.sync: HARD CUT. Highest novelty score in the track (0.86).
shots.continuity_in: hard cut from black; everything returns at once — the light burst lands with the chorus
shots.continuity_out: full choreography at maximum energy, orbiting
shots.lyric_intent: the unknown flung open at full volume — the song's thesis returns (L23 LIVE AI 把未知全部打開)
shots.caption: LIVE AI

shots.camera: multi-angle chorus block, hero shot into crowd wide, cut every 2 bars
shots.action: sustained final chorus, first half - hero shot on the downbeat, then a crowd wide as the arena lights sweep
shots.sync: loudest sustained passage. 4 bars, 3 internal cuts at 2-bar lines (104.64 / 106.91 / 109.17)
shots.continuity_in: final chorus hero shot on the downbeat, energy already at full
shots.continuity_out: crowd wide as the arena lights sweep; internal cuts land on 2-bar lines
shots.lyric_intent: each internal 2-bar cut = one inspiration changing tomorrow (L24 每一個靈感都可能改變明天)

shots.camera: close-ups on each 2-bar line, tightening in
shots.action: sustained final chorus, second half - alternating close-ups tightening toward the climax handoff
shots.sync: 3 bars, cuts at 113.71 / 115.97. Ends flush on the climax downbeat at 118.22
shots.continuity_in: tightening close-ups from the S23A final wide, each 2-bar line a new frame
shots.continuity_out: climax handoff — the energy at its highest, ready to hand to the hero
shots.lyric_intent: tightening close-ups: not waiting for the future — arriving (L26 這不是等待未來 → L27 LIVE AI)

shots.camera: final hero pose, slow pull-back to wide
shots.action: peak energy - she holds the final hero pose as the camera pulls back through the full arena, every light on her
shots.sync: track peak (loudest passage, bass 1.6x). Ends exactly on the 2:09.54 bass collapse
shots.continuity_in: peak energy hero; the camera begins its slow pull-back through the arena
shots.continuity_out: she holds the final hero pose, the full arena lit on her, bass seconds from collapsing
shots.lyric_intent: held hero pose: imagination made real, the camera pulling back through the created world (L28 讓想像成真 → LIVE AI)

shots.camera: wide, static, lights falling away; hard cut to logo on the final hit
shots.action: the bass collapses - lights fall away one bank at a time, she holds the pose in near-darkness; CSFCCA logo flares on the final transient and freezes
shots.sync: HARD CUT at 129.55 (outro collapse). Final transient 0.96 at 132.90 - the logo lands there and holds to 134.30
shots.continuity_in: the bass collapses at 2:09.54; the lights start dying bank by bank in sequence
shots.continuity_out: near-darkness; the logo flares on the final transient and freezes to the end
shots.lyric_intent: the brand seals the outro; lights dying = the world resting after creation (L32 CSFCCA LIVE AI)
shots.caption: See you on the next stage.
